description: Ministry of Water Supply - Constructions of Penaktiyawa Water treatment Plant under Thaldena Meegahakiwula Water Supply Project, Indivitiya Pump House No. 10 under Stage II Ja-ela, Ekala Water disposal project, Halloluwa Booster Pump House
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains multiple orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific land parcels for water treatment plants and pump house construction projects. The content includes detailed descriptions of land boundaries, locations, extents, and claimant information, which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While a government minister is named, this is incidental to the core land acquisition purpose rather than being about government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
